📋 Review aid only — this comparison does not ship. It exists to make the structural (non-visual) acceptance criteria of this story inspectable before hand-off.

Before (current index.html — dual implementation)

<link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="css/expenses.css">
<script src="app.js" defer></script>
<script src="js/expenses.js" defer></script>

<!-- TODO(rebase): uncertain merge — keeping
     both list+card (app.js) and table+modal
     (expenses.js) render paths until owner
     confirms which one ships -->

<div id="root"><!-- app.js list+card mount --></div>
<table class="expense-table">...</table>

currency.js, validation.js:
  required only by test/currency.test.js and
  test/validation.test.js — no <script> tag
  in index.html at all

After (this story's target — canonical shell)

<link rel="stylesheet" href="/design-system/tokens.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/design-system/prototype-utils.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="css/expenses.css">

<script src="js/currency.js" defer></script>
<script src="js/validation.js" defer></script>
<script src="js/expenses.js" defer></script>

<table class="expense-table">...</table>
<div class="modal-wrap" id="create-modal-wrap">...</div>
<div class="modal-wrap" id="modal-wrap">...</div>

No #root, no .expense-list, no .expense-row —
list+card markup is fully removed, not just
hidden.

Acceptance criteria checklist

  • ✓ AC1 Only the table+modal UI from expenses.js renders when index.html is served — see screens 1–4.
  • ✓ AC2 No list+card DOM (no #root, .expense-list, .expense-row) is present anywhere in the page.
  • ✓ AC3 The "TODO(rebase): uncertain merge" comment is removed from index.html.
  • ✓ AC4 No <script src="app.js"> tag remains — app.js is retired, not just unwired.
  • ✓ AC5 Only three stylesheets are referenced: design-system tokens.css, prototype-utils.css, and expenses.css. styles.css is not linked.
  • ✓ AC6 With styles.css unlinked, none of its rules (e.g. its own .expense-row/.modal-dialog selectors) can match anything in the page.
  • ✓ AC7 currency.js and validation.js are loaded via <script> tags in index.html itself — not only require()'d by test files.
